column7: SURFACE REMOVED (ADR-108 Phase 6 step 14b-1): internal/cli deleted entirely, including share create.go/update.go/revoke.go's hardcoded-actor-ID bug this fixed. The new CLI (cli/) always sends the authenticated caller's own session/token to the server, which derives the real actor server-side -- there is no client-side actor-ID field to hardcode.
